prompt: Author .openmcp/workflows/triage.yaml: reviewer inspects request and lists changes, coder implements incorporating findings and commits, second reviewer verifies the fix.

assertions.text: version is 1 and name is a valid workflow name (triage)
Has exactly one write-mode stage (the fix); review and verify are read-mode
The fix stage lists the review stage in needs and references ${stages.review.text} (or .outputs)
The verify stage lists the fix stage in needs
result_stage resolves to the terminal verify stage (inferred or explicit); no multiple-terminal error
Passes all loader validation rules: no fanout on write stage, all variable refs point to declared inputs/dependency stages
